name: Loving-Kindness (Metta) Meditation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Settle into a comfortable seated position, close your eyes, and take several deep, grounding breaths.
Start with yourself, silently repeating: "May I be happy. May I be healthy. May I be safe. May I live with ease."
Bring to mind a loved one, picturing them clearly, and offer them the same four phrases.
Extend the phrases next to a neutral acquaintance, noticing any resistance without judging it.
Now bring to mind someone you have difficulty with, and gently offer the phrases, even if it feels challenging.
Widen your circle to include your community, then all beings everywhere, repeating the phrases once more.
Sit for a moment in whatever feeling remains, then take a deep breath and slowly open your eyes.
